name: sotf-forest-day
about: Sons of the Forest's daytime forest interiors: twenty frames from Endnight's Steam store screenshots and three official trailers, measured with the player's hands left in (research/2026-10-14-sotf-forest-look.md); the middle third's brown share is that note's `brownMid`, by the same hues. The lush forest's target by day (D286). Its debug tint, lilac, hard edges, facets and flat colour were measured by look.ts on 2026-10-15 from the same twenty frames, the rest left as the research measured them. Its flat foliage, leaf colour and lit leaves (D368) were measured by look.ts on 2026-10-15 from the same twenty frames, the 20 with leaves enough to say.
